FCSBL drives one signal (3 lamps: Red, Green1, Green2) on Port B bits 0,2,4 (interleaved with the motor bits, corrected from an earlier statement of consecutive bits 4,5,6). Which specific bit is which color is discovered via Config menu 2 (Signal Scan).

Signal numbering is explicitly deferred in PlanExtended.md ('The letters we use there is now converted to numbers. Will come back to that.') -- the signals section below stays structurally unconfigured even though the candidate bits are known.
